user.title: Connect to TVHub
user.description: Where your TVHub server runs (the one at http://IP:8080). If you set TVHUB_TOKEN, enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach TVHub. Check the IP, the port, and that the port is published on your network (not just 127.0.0.1).
error.invalid_auth: TVHub asks for a token and it is missing or wrong.

abort.already_configured: This TVHub server is already configured.

send_key.name: Send key
send_key.description: Sends a remote key to the TV (DPAD_UP, DPAD_CENTER, BACK, HOME, MENU, MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE, VOLUME_UP…).
